label: August 3–9, 2026
intro: Calm after the holiday rush — ideal week to do the Marvel Experience, squeeze in a craft session, or hit the rink before the BICT children's theatre festival arrives Aug 21.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.price: Check Klook for up to 45% off
activities.why: 2 hours inside the Marvel universe: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, Flight Training VR booth, 4D stereoscopic dome, and character meet-and-greets with Iron Man, Thor, Spiderman, and Hulk. Built for exactly a 5-year-old Iron Man fan. If you haven't gone yet, this is the week.
activities.tip: Book on Klook ahead of time. Quiet post-holiday week = shorter queues. BTS to On Nut + Grab (30 min).

activities.title: Toob North at theCOMMONS Cloud 11
activities.price: Free to browse; sessions priced individually
activities.why: Northern Thai potters and craftspeople are still in residence through end of August. Great for hands-on building & making — watch live pottery, try a clay session, eat something from Chiang Mai.
activities.tip: August is quieter post-holiday — better access to the makers and more personal sessions.

activities.title: Roller Dome at Emporium
activities.why: Regular rollerblading session at SE Asia's biggest indoor rink. Each visit builds Thor's skating confidence — coaches available for progression.
activities.tip: Sunday morning is the quietest slot.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit
activities.why: Weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are the least crowded — perfect for Thor to build ice confidence without the weekend rush. Layer up, it's cold!
activities.tip: A private 1-hour lesson (2,000 THB) is great value if Thor wants to improve fast.

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Chocolate Workshop
activities.why: Monthly kids bonbon-making sessions with real Thai craft chocolate. Book the August slot now before it fills.
activities.tip: Follow on LINE Official for exact dates.

activities.title: 📅 Coming up: BICT Fest — Bangkok Children's Theatre Festival
activities.location: One Bangkok Park, Goethe-Institut Thailand, Sodsai Centre
activities.why: The 5th Bangkok International Children's Theatre Festival: 11 interactive performances from 9 countries, with the theme 'Play Attention: Look Who's Growing Up!' Shows are participatory — kids interact and explore alongside artists, not just sit and watch. Mark the calendar now.
activities.tip: Check bictfest.com this week — free programme slots open early and go fast.
